items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: We had this Alice Wills on trombone

ctx.x: I say -- but they could play. But you still needed a reputation behind you. Basie hadn't even got any -- and we opened up in Rochester, in a preview, and Duke came up, had Duke to come up and a few other guys, to see what they thought about the band.

And some of the guys said, well, I don't like the girls, they're playing too much like boys, because they had them fanning hats, and they said, that don't look nice. And they wanted pretty girls like a melody, like this. Ina Hutton didn't like this, see, I want to swing like Basie, so the band got so they could swing. They had good musicians, of course, We had this Alice Wills on trombone, who travelled (inaudible). And she played 26 instruments perfectly. Played 26 different instruments. And she was a blond,…
Got a girl out of a conservatory out of Zanesville, Ohio, played a piano. They could really play, see. So you had to have (inaudible) band but you got to know your limitations.
